title: service-knowledge: a package duplicate that the knowledge service itself refuses is told to "save the source" and that "Nothing was written"
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

Filing gate: ① follow-up of PR #38208 (#38058; contract record 7235658537 §③ note 1, which asks for it to be filed) · Source: topic #37000
Grading: area:ai · Bug · p3 (suggested: wording at the duplicate door; status and code are right) · reach: an administrator duplicating a package that holds a `knowledge_source` on a deployment that runs the platform's knowledge service (the common path) · evidence: read of PR #38208 at b85886609d by the contract review; `packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-service.ts` composes `was not saved` (~3149), `Nothing was written; try again.` (~3157) and `have someone who may query it save the source` (~3215, 3226, 3228), and `refuseDuplicatedKnowledgeSources` appends a service verdict verbatim.
Dedupe: `is:issue knowledge duplicate door service verdict wording` → checked at filing; open: #38058 (the parent) only.
Reader: area o1-C of seat repo:objectstack#1 claims it after triage's first touch.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：复制一个含知识源的应用包时，如果知识服务本身拒绝(比如权限不够)，报错里照搬了"保存"时的说法：叫人"再保存一次知识源"、说"什么都没写入"，对复制操作的人来说不对。
- 做什么：知识服务给出拒绝理由时也区分是"保存"还是"复制"，复制时说"没有复制"并让人重新复制。
- 谁受益：复制应用包的管理员(报错能照着做)。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
PR #38208 gave the predicate-composed refusals a `door: 'save' | 'duplicate'` wording. The knowledge service's own `admitAuthoredSource` verdicts still pass verbatim through the package-duplicate door. Let the door reach the service's verdict wording (for example a `door` input on `admitAuthoredSource`, or a duplicate-door rewrite of the service's remedy tail), so that a duplicate is told "cannot be copied … duplicate the package again", with no "save the source" and no second "nothing was written". The save door's bytes stay unchanged.

## Acceptance
- On a real kernel running `KnowledgeServicePlugin`, each service verdict reached through the duplicate door (the 503 transient and the 403 query-permission arms) says nothing was copied exactly once and tells the caller to duplicate again, with no "save the source" and no "Nothing was written".
- Control: the same verdicts at the `/meta` save door are byte-identical to before.
- The pins go red when the door's wording is reverted.

Blocked-by: #38208
